candidate.label: A low-shot density/counting model (DAVE / GeCo family)
candidate.license: research-use terms upstream; verify before any commercial use
candidate.produces: a count, and in the density families a density map
candidate.cannot_produce: a calibrated occupancy field, and nothing at all without exemplars

unavailable_reason: The low-shot counters need exemplar boxes or a text prompt, which makes them operations rather than producers of a standing field; and their published terms are research-use. `extent.density_field` also does not need a model to be well formed: its counts come from an existing extent set, and only the smoothing needs deciding. Measured rather than modelled is the cheaper and more honest route, so no weights were fetched.
